EXPRESS COLLECTIBLES — BUSINESS CARD
Artboards are full-bleed 3.625×2.125 in at 96 px/in (348×204 px). Trim = 3.5×2 in (6 px off each edge); text sits inside the safe zone.
The QR is a vCard: scanning saves Neal's full contact card — name, shop, phone, address, email, website and every handle — so the info survives even if this was the last card on the counter.
VERIFY BEFORE PRINT: eBay handle shown as @expresscollectibles (couldn't find the eBay store publicly — correct it if different) · phone (618) 882-6660 (public listing for 806 3rd St) · email neal_knebel@yahoo.com (from the Facebook page).
300-dpi print files: express-collectibles/business-card/print/ in the Fenix5ive repo.
